entities.name: Greco-Bactrian Kingdom
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Greco-Bactrian Kingdom, a political institution in Afghanistan during Achaemenid and Hellenistic Afghanistan (330 BCE–150 BCE). Grew from Achaemenid Satrapies and Persian Empire. Led to the emergence of Greco-Bactrian king Demetrius I invades India, beginning the Indo-Greek period.
